chunk_map.heading: The best mitigation is the door you don't open

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L4 'Before the agent reads anything' and L6 'the insight pages' come closest: 'the agent' is the generic actor of the whole training and 'the insight pages' is a spine noun backed by the training's memory design (backing L18), so the arc-earned spine-vocabulary carve-out holds; harm (reader cannot tell what is meant) is absent since L6 glosses them as where source lines get folded into. 'Its' (L6) resolves to 'a source' in the same sentence run; 'it' (L8) to the leaving-out decision.
No positional pointer to another file in body L1-9; closest L6 'the insight pages' names its object rather than pointing by position.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'the X you did/saw/caught' in body L1-9; closest L4 'The folder nobody remembers sharing' is a hypothetical, not a beat.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no guess-before-reveal or demo beat; slide is declarative argument

rules_evaluated.evidence: L4-8: slide carries its own claim (decide what never gets read; later removal is costly; cost of exclusion) in three paragraphs, standalone.
L1 'The best mitigation is the door you don't open' vs L4 'decide what it never gets to read' and L6 'A source you never let in needs no such hunt': header true to content.

Closest: L4 three short 'The ...' noun sentences (interview notes, ticket export, folder): distinct concrete objects, not anaphora with an empty third leg; no 'Not X. Not Y.', no self-grading superlative about the training, no number+retraction, no empty verb triplet.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep for surface|firing|compendium|forcing function|beat|mood in body L1-9 -> 0 hits; closest L6 'insight pages', plain wording for the audience's own memory artifact.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep '\*\*' in body L1-9 -> 0 bold elements (budget <=1).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: slide file included via a lecture; presence is the including file's judgement, no phase-less section here

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-numbering.js --file curriculum/slides/the-door-you-dont-open.md -> OK, exit 0; no Phase/Step headers.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file curriculum/slides/the-door-you-dont-open.md -> OK, no page-geometry pointers, exit 0.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no links in body; rule is explicitly not a gate

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L1 'The best mitigation is the door you don't open' is a claim, correct for a lecture-type slide.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: L8 'an agent that reaches less is easier for the whole team to trust' adds a new reason (team trust) not in header or L6, so not a restating kicker; no doctrine restatement or design commentary.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L1 header promises avoidance before reading; L4, L6 and L8 all answer it; maintainer STATUS L12 records a fresh rewrite, no inherited old-header bullets.

notes: Single-slide file; no H1/lede, so chunk 0 is the one ## slide. Class brief built (17 rules, 0 parked). 'the insight pages' (L6) resolves only if the host deck has earned it; check in the including lecture.
